name: Geometría de Escena
algorithm: Scene Geometry Consistency — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes scene geometry consistency for deepfake detection:

1. **3D Scene Reconstrucción**: From video frames, approximate 3D scene geometry is estimated using structure-from-motion, depth estimation, and perspective cues. The spatial layout — room dimensions, furniture positions, wall angles — is reconstructed.

2. **Geométrico Consistencia Verificación**: The estimated scene geometry should remain consistent across all frames. The method tracks 3D reconstruction consistency — deformations, scale changes, or geometric shifts indicate manipulation where inserted content doesn't match the scene's 3D structure.

3. **Person - Scene Perspective Match**: The person (particularly face scale and perspective distortion) should be consistent with their position in the 3D scene. Face size should scale correctly with estimated distance from camera. Deepfake composites may show faces at incorrect apparent distances — face scale inconsistent with scene geometry.

4. **Sombra - Geometry Agreement**: Shadows in the scene should be consistent with the 3D geometry and estimated illumination. Ground shadows, cast shadows, and attached shadows should all agree with a single light model and the scene geometry. Manipulated scenes may show shadow-geometry conflicts.

5. **Cámara Movimiento - Scene Geometry Coherencia**: As the camera moves, the relative motion of objects at different depths (motion parallax) should be consistent with the scene geometry. The method analyzes motion parallax patterns — composited elements at wrong estimated depths produce incorrect parallax, revealing manipulation.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante scene geometry consistency analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva
